name: Tires
description: Factory ZL1 1LE: Goodyear Eagle F1 SuperCar 3R 305/30R19 front, 325/30R19 rear (good for ~1.10 g). ZL1: Eagle F1 SuperCar 3 285/30ZR20 / 305/30ZR20. Race: DOT R-compound or slicks on 18–19 in wheels; pressures set by hot targets measured immediately after the session.

components.name: Front tire
components.description: Front tire. On a 3,700 lb car the fronts carry braking load and turn-in; pick a size that the front arch and steering lock tolerate at full bump with camber.

factory.name: Goodyear Eagle F1 SuperCar 3R 305/30R19 (ZL1 1LE)
factory.notes: Load/speed 98Y per wheel-size. ZL1: Eagle F1 SuperCar 3 285/30ZR20. Door placard pressure 35 psi (2.4 bar) cold for street.

raceOptions.name: Hoosier R7 (DOT R-compound), e.g. 315/30R18 or 305/35R19-class sizes
raceOptions.notes: Common NASA/SCCA time-trial/racing tire; confirm available sizes.

raceOptions.name: Goodyear Eagle RS / Racing Eagle slicks
Pirelli P Zero DHD/DHF slick, Michelin Pilot Sport GT/S9, Yokohama Advan A005/A052

specs.Race hot target (typical starting point): R-compound ≈ 36–40 psi hot; slicks ≈ 28–34 psi hot – use tire maker data and pyrometer

installNotes: Mount with a new valve core/grommet; balance; set cold pressure from previous session's hot data.
inspection: Hot pressures and probe temps (inside/middle/outside) immediately after each session.
Tread depth/heat cycles log; look for chunking and cords.
